sloka: वृताम् नाना विधैर् वृक्षैः पुष्प उपग फल उपगैः ।कोकिलैर् भृन्ग राजैः च मत्तैर् नित्य निषेविताम् ॥५-१४-७॥
transliteration: vṛtām nānā vidhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpa upaga phala upagaiḥ ।kokilair bhṛnga rājaiḥ ca mattair nitya niṣevitām ॥5-14-7॥

translations.english: Entering deep into the grove, Hanuman saw clusters of trees pleasing to look at, herds of animals and flocks of colourful birds singing melodious notes.The grove was surrounded on all sides by silvery and golden trees which looked colourful with flocks of birds and herds of deer. It was full of lovely thickets looking like the rising sun. It was fringed with various trees bearing abundance of fruits and flowers. It was inhabited by intoxicated cuckoos, bees, proud peacocks and numerous lovely birds.
translations.hindi: सैकड़ों रंग-वि गे पक्षी जो श्रपनी चोंचों में फूलों को दबाए हुए थे, भ्राभूषणों से सजे हुए से जान पड़ते थे | जड़ से लेकर फुनगी तक फूले हुए आर मन को हर्षित करने वाले श्रशोक वृक्ष
